purpose: Neutral material-only reference for the isolated Cloudflare 9B style probe
role: Texture structure only; book cover supplies subject and palette
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: reusable neutral material reference for AI book-spine illustration, NOT a book spine itself. Create one square, edge-to-edge, flat orthographic macro scan of premium fine woven bookbinding cloth. Quiet warm ivory / near-neutral stone grey, natural linen and cotton fibers with fine irregular weave, subtle realistic thread thickness, gentle pigment granulation, very slight handling wear, tactile but restrained microdetail. The weave must look fine and elegant at book scale, never coarse burlap, synthetic plastic, or digital white noise. Uniform soft diffuse lighting, no shading gradient, no cast shadows, no directional highlights. Continuous material across the entire frame, with no edges of a swatch or book visible. This reference will guide ONLY material quality: keep it achromatic enough that the separate book cover can dictate the final artwork palette. No illustrations, figures, landscapes, planets, lines, frames, ornaments, symbols, gold flecks, text, letters, numbers, logos, embossing, watermarks or objects. Output only the single high-quality neutral cloth surface.
